title:
Good Parenting is all you need
Multi-agentic LLM Hallucination Mitigation

defines.name: Good Parenting
defines.definition: A multi-agent LLM workflow for detecting and correcting hallucinations in generated content through a primary agent and a reviewing agent.

problem: LLM-generated content can contain hallucinations, and existing methods do not adequately integrate detection and correction into autonomous multi-agent workflows.
